text:
Sampled ranking can reverse model comparisons: strong separation from training negatives does not establish strong catalog ranking. [Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/) establish this inconsistency; [RecSys 2025 research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.05398) separates sampling resolution, fidelity, exposure robustness and preference validity. Implication: retain pinned 99-negative macro validation HR@10 for selection; treat catalog audits as complementary diagnostics. Proposed bounded audit: prespecify users and training-only prefix/next-item pairs, stream eligible catalog items in chunks, count scores exceeding each target, document ties and exclusions. This measures catalog competition on those examples, not generalization or unobserved preferences.

Numerical preflight should precede expensive audits. NVIDIA documents `CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8` or `:16:8` for reproducibility; configure before CUDA initialization when deterministic GEMMs require it. This addresses a configuration-related failure, not every cuBLAS error—retain the exact traceback. [NVIDIA documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/12.5.1/pdf/CUBLAS_Library.pdf). Proposed checks: finite features/scores, valid indices and shapes, repeated scoring, checkpoint–predictor agreement, and chunked-versus-direct scoring on a small catalog subset. PyTorch warns that batching can change floating-point results; inspect near-tie rank sensitivity rather than demand bitwise equality. [PyTorch numerical notes](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/docs/source/notes/numerical_accuracy.md).

Diagnostic usefulness remains a prospective hypothesis. Prespecify each metric, expected intervention and direction; record subsequent host HR@10 changes, including failures, across all four categories. Keep one NextItNet checkpoint/category and fixed evaluation. Repeated validation-guided search creates selection optimism; trial logging and bounded hypotheses improve interpretability but cannot remove it. Reserve held-out conclusions for the host’s final evaluation. [Model-selection bias research](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html).
